environment: M1 Max 32 GB with ~15 GB held by other apps (Xcode, lldb, Safari, Codex, node); swap 29/30 GB used. All numbers are under this memory pressure.
gpu_expert_cache_conclusion: GPU memory and the macOS file cache are the same RAM; a resident expert cache evicts the file cache and triggers swapping. Default 0 GB.
prediction_diagnosis: GPU wait grows 0.39 -> 2.2 s/token; vm_stat decompressions scale with read volume (+2.3M for 8, +5.6M for 12). Fresh numpy + MLX buffers per layer (~10 GB/token churn) make macOS compress the 6.5 GB GPU trunk. Default predict=False until read buffers are reused (C engine design).
ceiling: decode needs ~80 MB of experts per layer: ~12 ms at 6.5 GB/s raw SSD vs ~8 ms GPU work, so ~0.6 s/token is the realistic floor without free RAM for the file cache; the C engine (0.66) is near it
